dedupe_keys.name: enagad european natural gas demand database

description: The European Natural Gas Demand database (ENaGaD) gives daily time series of national natural gas demand for each of the 25 EU Member States with a gas transmission system and some other European countries. Version 1.1 was published in March 2022 through the Publications Office of the European Union and Zenodo by Nicola Zaccarelli, Sergio Giaccaria, Maksims Feofilovs and Ricardo Bolado-Lavin of the Joint Research Centre energy security team, alongside a JRC report. Series run from 2015 to 2020 in energy units, collected mainly from the transparency platforms of national transmission system operators under Regulation (EC) No 715/2009. Where possible, daily demand is split into consumption by electricity and heat producers, industrial users and households. Coverage is Europe. The data are a zipped archive, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost; a newer version that supersedes 1.1 is announced in the JRC Data Catalogue. Caveats: sector splits are not available for every country, and version 1.1 ends in 2020. Simulation uses are gas network and security of supply modelling, cold spell demand peaks and gas-to-power coupling studies. Related records: data-gb-hourly-local-gas-demand gives local hourly demand for Great Britain.
